015import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;

018import paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo;
019import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;

022import java.io.BufferedWriter;
023import java.io.IOException;
024import java.io.Reader;
025import java.nio.file.Files;
026import java.nio.file.Path;

029import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

031
032import static paint.shared.constants.PaintDirectories.DIR_BRIGHTFIELD_IMAGES;
033import static paint.shared.constants.PaintDirectories.DIR_TRACKMATE_IMAGES;
034
035import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV;
036import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON;
037import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.RECORDINGS_CSV;
038import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.TRACKS_CSV;
039
040import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
041
042import static paint.shared.utils.CsvUtils.concatenateCsvFiles;
043import static paint.shared.utils.CsvUtils.countProcessed;
044import static paint.shared.utils.Miscellaneous.formatDuration;

046/**
047 * Provides functionality to execute the TrackMate analysis workflow for a single
048 * experiment. Each experiment typically contains one or more recordings that
049 * are processed sequentially.
050 * <p>
051 * The workflow includes:
052 * <ul>
053 *   <li>Initializing configuration and runtime settings.</li>
054 *   <li>Running TrackMate per recording in a monitored thread.</li>
055 *   <li>Recording runtime statistics and aggregating results.</li>
056 *   <li>Supporting user cancellation and timeouts via watchdog control.</li>
057 * </ul>
058 */
059public class RunTrackMateOnExperiment extends RunTrackMateOnRecording {
060
061    /**
062     * The current verbosity setting.
063     * <p>
064     * Read at call time, deliberately. This used to be a {@code static final} field initialised
065     * from {@link PaintRuntime#isVerbose()}, which captured the value once at class load — so
066     * ticking the Verbose checkbox (which calls {@link PaintRuntime#setVerbose}) had no effect on
067     * a TrackMate run at all. Same trap as the config flag frozen in a static initialiser.
068     *
069     * @return {@code true} if verbose logging is currently enabled
070     */
071    private static boolean verbose() {
072        return PaintRuntime.isVerbose();
073    }
074
075    /**
076     * Executes a given task within a monitored thread using a watchdog.
077     * The watchdog ensures that the task completes within a specified time limit
078     * or terminates early if the user cancels processing.
079     *
080     * @param task                   the {@link Runnable} task to execute
081     * @param maxSecondsPerRecording time limit for execution in seconds
082     * @param dialog                 optional {@link ProjectDialog} that can signal cancellation
083     * @return {@code true} if the task completed successfully;
084     *         {@code false} if cancelled or timed out
085     */
086    private static boolean runWithWatchdog(Runnable task,
087            int maxSecondsPerRecording,
088            ProjectDialog dialog) {
089
090        Thread thread = new Thread(task, "TrackMateThread");
091        thread.start();
092
093        int numberOfDotsOnline = 0;
094
095        for (int i = 0; i < maxSecondsPerRecording; i++) {
096            try {
097                // Wait up to 1 second for TrackMate thread to finish
098                thread.join(1000);
099            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
100                // Should not happen anymore — no interrupts sent
101                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
102                PaintLogger.errorf("Watchdog thread was interrupted.");
103                return false;
104            }
105
106            // Finished normally
107            if (!thread.isAlive()) {
108                return true;
109            }
110
111            // User pressed Cancel → do NOT interrupt TrackMate
112            if (dialog != null && dialog.isCancelled()) {
113                PaintLogger.warnf("User requested cancellation — allowing TrackMate to exit cleanly…");
114                // DO NOT CALL thread.interrupt() — this causes FutureTask.get() to throw InterruptedException
115                return false;
116            }
117
118            // Progress dots: one per second of waiting, 80 to a line.
119            // (There used to be a "numberOfInterrupts" counter gating this, but it was
120            // incremented, tested against >= 1 and reset on every pass — so it always fired.)
121            PaintLogger.raw(".");
122            numberOfDotsOnline++;
123
124            if (numberOfDotsOnline >= 80) {
125                PaintLogger.raw("\n                                                    ");
126                numberOfDotsOnline = 0;
127            }
128        }
129
130        // Timeout — again, do NOT interrupt TrackMate
131        PaintLogger.errorf("   TrackMate - exceeded time limit of %d seconds.", maxSecondsPerRecording);
132        return false;
133    }
134
135    /**
136     * Runs the TrackMate workflow for a single experiment.
137     * Reads experiment configuration, processes each recording in sequence,
138     * and aggregates results into consolidated output files.
139     *
140     * @param experimentPath the directory of the experiment (contains CSV files)
141     * @param imagesPath     the directory containing corresponding image data
142     * @param dialog         optional {@link ProjectDialog} for user cancellation
143     * @return {@code true} if all recordings processed successfully;
144     *         {@code false} if errors or cancellations occurred
145     */
146    public static boolean runTrackMateOnExperiment(Path experimentPath,
147            Path imagesPath,
148            ProjectDialog dialog) {
149
150        PaintLogger.debugf("RunTrackMateOnExperiment.runTrackMateOnExperiment - Starting");
151
152        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
153        // Initial setup
154        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
155        Duration totalDuration           = Duration.ZERO;
156        int      numberRecordings        = 0;
157        boolean  status                  = true;
158        List<Path> processedTrackFiles   = new ArrayList<>();
159
160        // Initialize configuration
161        Path configPath = experimentPath.getParent().resolve(PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON);
162        if (Files.exists(configPath)) {
163            PaintConfig.initialise(experimentPath.getParent());
164        } else {
165            PaintLogger.warnf("No PaintConfig.json found in %s, defaults will be used.",
166                              experimentPath.getParent());
167        }
168
169        TrackMateConfig trackMateConfig = new TrackMateConfig();
170        int maxSecondsPerRecording      = trackMateConfig.getMaxNumberOfSecondsPerImage();
171
172        if (verbose()) {
173            PaintLogger.infof(trackMateConfig.toString());
174        }
175
176        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
177        // Validate input files
178        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
179        Path experimentFilePath   = experimentPath.resolve(EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV);
180        Path allRecordingFilePath = experimentPath.resolve(RECORDINGS_CSV);
181
182        if (!Files.exists(experimentFilePath)) {
183            PaintLogger.errorf("Experiment info file does not exist: %s", experimentFilePath);
184            return false;
185        }
186
187        int    numberRecordingsToProcess = countProcessed(experimentFilePath);
188        String experimentName            = experimentPath.getFileName().toString();
189        String projectName               = experimentPath.getParent().getFileName().toString();
190
191        PaintLogger.blankline();
192        PaintLogger.infof("Processing %d recording%s in experiment '%s' (project '%s').",
193                          numberRecordingsToProcess,
194                          numberRecordingsToProcess == 1 ? "" : "s",
195                          experimentName,
196                          projectName);
197        PaintLogger.blankline();
198
199        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
200        // Process Experiment Info and Recordings
201        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
202        try (Reader experimentInfoReader = TextFiles.newReader(experimentFilePath);
203             CSVParser experimentInfoParser = new CSVParser(experimentInfoReader,
204                                                            CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
205                                                                             .setHeader()
206                                                                             .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
207                                                                             .build());
208             BufferedWriter allRecordingsWriter = Files.newBufferedWriter(allRecordingFilePath);
209             CSVPrinter allRecordingsPrinter = new CSVPrinter(allRecordingsWriter, CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder().build())) {
210
211            // Extend the Experiment Info header for RECORDINGS_CSV
212            List<String> header = new ArrayList<>(experimentInfoParser.getHeaderMap().keySet());
213            header.addAll(Arrays.asList(
214                    NUMBER_OF_SPOTS,
215                    NUMBER_OF_TRACKS,
216                    NUMBER_OF_TRACKS_IN_BACKGROUND,
217                    NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_BACKGROUND,
218                    AVERAGE_TRACKS_IN_BACKGROUND,
219                    NUMBER_OF_SPOTS_IN_ALL_TRACKS,
220                    NUMBER_OF_FRAMES,
221                    RUN_TIME,
222                    TIME_STAMP,
223                    EXCLUDE,
224                    TAU,
225                    R_SQUARED,
226                    DENSITY,
227                    MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO,
228                    MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED,
229                    MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY,
230                    NEIGHBOUR_MODE
231            ));
232            allRecordingsPrinter.printRecord(header);
233
234            // Iterate through experiment records
235            for (CSVRecord experientInfoRecord : experimentInfoParser) {
236
237                if (dialog != null && dialog.isCancelled()) {
238                    PaintLogger.warnf("User requested cancellation. Stopping.");
239                    break;
240                }
241
242                try {
243                    Map<String, String> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
244                    for (String key : experimentInfoParser.getHeaderMap().keySet()) {
245                        row.put(key, experientInfoRecord.get(key));
246                    }
247
248                    ExperimentInfo experimentInfo           = new ExperimentInfo(row);
249                    String         recordingName            = experimentInfo.getRecordingName();
250                    int            numberOfSpots            = 0;
251                    int            numberOfFilteredTracks   = 0;
252                    int            numberOfSpotsInAllTracks = 0;
253                    int            numberOfFrames           = 0;
254                    int            runTime                  = 0;
255                    String         timeStamp                = "";
256
257                    if (experimentInfo.isProcessFlagSet()) {
258                        double threshold = experimentInfo.getThreshold();
259
260                        Files.createDirectories(experimentPath.resolve(DIR_BRIGHTFIELD_IMAGES));
261                        Files.createDirectories(experimentPath.resolve(DIR_TRACKMATE_IMAGES));
262
263                        PaintLogger.infof("   Recording '%s' started TrackMate processing.", recordingName);
264
265                        // The following is necessary because of how Java handles variable capture inside lambdas or inner classes.
266                        // We are not changing the variable trackMateResults itself (the reference to the array never changes),
267                        // We pass the address of the array that does not change, but the contents can change.
268                        final TrackMateResults[] trackMateResults = new TrackMateResults[1];
269                        final Throwable[]        trackMateFailure = new Throwable[1];
270
271                        // Run TrackMate in a monitored thread
272                        boolean finished = runWithWatchdog(() -> {
273                            try {
274                                trackMateResults[0] = RunTrackMateOnRecording.runTrackMateOnRecording(
275                                        experimentPath, imagesPath, trackMateConfig, threshold, experimentInfo, dialog);
276                            } catch (Exception e) {
277                                // Capture the real cause so it can be reported below, rather than
278                                // leaving only a generic "failed" message with no diagnostic.
279                                trackMateFailure[0] = e;
280                            }
281                        }, maxSecondsPerRecording, dialog);
282
283                        // Handle failures and cancellations
284                        if (!finished) {
285                            if (dialog != null && dialog.isCancelled()) {
286                                PaintLogger.infof("Recording '%s' cancelled cleanly.", recordingName);
287                                break;
288                            } else {
289                                PaintLogger.errorf("   TrackMate failed or timed out for '%s'.", recordingName);
290                                if (trackMateFailure[0] != null) {
291                                    PaintLogger.error("      Cause of TrackMate failure:", trackMateFailure[0]);
292                                }
293                                PaintLogger.blankline();
294                                status = false;
295                                continue;
296                            }
297                        }
298
299                        // Validate processing results
300                        if (trackMateResults[0] == null || !trackMateResults[0].isSuccess()) {
301                            PaintLogger.errorf("   TrackMate failed for '%s'.", recordingName);
302                            if (trackMateFailure[0] != null) {
303                                PaintLogger.error("      Cause of TrackMate failure:", trackMateFailure[0]);
304                            }
305                            status = false;
306                            continue;
307                        }
308                        if (!trackMateResults[0].isCalculationPerformed()) {
309                            numberRecordings++;
310                            continue;
311                        }
312
313                        int durationInSeconds = (int) (trackMateResults[0].getDuration().toMillis() / 1000);
314                        PaintLogger.infof("   Recording '%s' processed in %s.", recordingName, formatDuration(durationInSeconds));
315                        PaintLogger.blankline();
316
317                        Path trackFilePath = experimentPath.resolve(recordingName + "-tracks.csv");
318                        processedTrackFiles.add(trackFilePath);
319                        totalDuration = totalDuration.plus(trackMateResults[0].getDuration());
320                        numberRecordings++;
321
322                        // Extract output values
323                        numberOfSpots            = trackMateResults[0].getNumberOfSpots();
324                        numberOfFilteredTracks   = trackMateResults[0].getNumberOfFilteredTracks();
325                        numberOfFrames           = trackMateResults[0].getNumberOfFrames();
326                        numberOfSpotsInAllTracks = trackMateResults[0].getNumberOfSpotsInAllTracks();
327                        runTime                  = durationInSeconds;
328                        timeStamp                = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME);
329
330                    } else if (verbose()) {
331                        PaintLogger.infof("   Recording '%s' skipped.", recordingName);
332                    }
333
334                    // Write summary output for this recording
335                    List<String> output = new ArrayList<>();
336                    for (String key : experimentInfoParser.getHeaderMap().keySet()) {
337                        output.add(row.get(key));
338                    }
339                    output.addAll(Arrays.asList(
340                            String.valueOf(numberOfSpots),
341                            String.valueOf(numberOfFilteredTracks),
342                            "",   // Number of Tracks in Background
343                            "",   // Squares in Background
344                            "",   // Average Tracks in Background
345                            String.valueOf(numberOfSpotsInAllTracks),
346                            String.valueOf(numberOfFrames),
347                            String.valueOf(runTime),
348                            timeStamp,
349                            "False",
350                            "",   // Tau
351                            "",   // R Squared
352                            "",   // Density
353                            "",   // Min Required Density Ratio
354                            "",   // Min Required R Squared
355                            "",   // Max Allowable Variability
356                            ""    // Neighbour Mode
357                    ));
358                    allRecordingsPrinter.printRecord(output);
359
360                } catch (Exception e) {
361                    if (dialog == null || !dialog.isCancelled()) {
362                        PaintLogger.errorf("Error processing recording: %s", e.getMessage());
363                    }
364                }
365            }
366
367        } catch (IOException e) {
368            if (dialog == null || !dialog.isCancelled()) {
369                PaintLogger.errorf("Error reading Experiment Info: %s", e.getMessage());
370            }
371            status = false;
372        }
373
374        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
375        // Finalize outputs and summaries
376        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
377        if (dialog != null && dialog.isCancelled()) {
378            PaintLogger.warnf("Cancellation processed.");
379            PaintLogger.blankline();
380            return false;
381        }
382
383        // Merge all per-recording tracks into a single CSV
384        Path tracksFilePath = experimentPath.resolve(TRACKS_CSV);
385        try {
386            concatenateCsvFiles(processedTrackFiles, tracksFilePath, true);
387        } catch (IOException e) {
388            PaintLogger.errorf("Error concatenating tracks: %s", e.getMessage());
389            status = false;
390        }
391
392        // Log final summary
393        PaintLogger.infof("Processed %d recordings in %s.",
394                          numberRecordings, formatDuration((int) (totalDuration.toMillis() / 1000)));
395        PaintLogger.blankline();
396        return status;
397    }
398}
